title: Cap. V Obj. 2: actual gift of eternal life bound to believers — therefore election from foresight faith
pass_a_gloss: Objection 2. The actual gift of eternal life is not more bound than the volition of giving the same: But the gift itself is bound to the faithful, and presupposes antecedent faith: Therefore also the volition of giving eternal life, which is nothing other than election. Election therefore is from foresight faith. Arminius and almost all who follow Arminius build many arguments from this principle, but frail and invalid.
pass_b_english: Obj. 2. The actual gift of eternal life is no more bound than the will to give it. But the gift itself is bound to the faithful and presupposes antecedent faith. Therefore the will to give eternal life — which is nothing other than election — is likewise bound. So election is from foresight faith. Arminius and almost all who follow him build many arguments from this principle — frail and invalid.
source_text: Obj. 2. Actualis vitae aeternae datio non magis est adstricta quam ejusdem dandae volitio: Sed ipsa datio adstricta est ad fideles, et fidem antecedentem praesupponit: Ergo et volitio dandae vitae aeternae, quae nihil aliud est quam electio. Electio itaque est ex fide praevisa. Arminius quique Arminium sectantur fere omnes ex hoc principio multa exstruunt argumenta, sed caduca et invalida.
